faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: What is this soap suitable for?
faq.a1: This herbal soap is suitable for face, body and hair cleansing. Made with natural plant ingredients, gentle enough for daily use.

faq.a2: Switching from synthetic products to natural soap may take some time to adjust. We recommend using it for 2-4 weeks and observing how your skin responds.

faq.a3: Oily scalps: every other day. Normal/dry scalps: 2-3 times per week. Adjust based on your scalp's response.

faq.a5: Keep in a dry, ventilated place. Use a draining soap dish to avoid prolonged soaking and extend its lifespan.
